name: Kinetic / dismemberment

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. One heavy bone crack, a deep solid thump and tearing fibers, followed by irregular dense physical fragments scattering and small wet impacts settling. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
